rationale: The agent did look up the user and order and fetched product details, which aligns with authentication and scoping to the correct order. However, it proceeded to execute exchange_delivered_order_items without first confirming the changes with the user, which violates the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. The conversation also does not show verification that the chosen replacements align with the user’s stated preferences (clicky switches with RGB, full size; fallback to no backlight if necessary) or any disclosure of costs or differences. The final message provides no confirmation details. Because a write was performed without explicit user confirmation, the interaction fails the pass bar.
